follow-up time: Through the course of the acute respiratory infection
cohort: 45 pregnant women, including 23 who suffered influenza of varying severity in the I-II trimesters of pregnancy.
finding: The study aimed to compare Viferon treatment to symptomatic therapy in pregnant women with acute respiratory infections, but the abstract does not provide results or conclusions to support a primary finding.
gest_age: Pregnant women were included in the examination at 12 weeks of gestation
